versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: The Avestan law against the demons — Fargard 2: Yima, the evil winters, and the vara

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of the Avestan *Vidēvdād* (Vendidad), the only book of the Sasanian Avesta canon to survive in its entirety. Initial scope: Fargard 2 — the Yima narrative, in which Ahura Mazda warns Yima of the destroying winters and commands the building of the *vara*, the enclosure preserving the seeds of every living kind. Source layer: romanized Avestan text after Geldner (*Avesta: the Sacred Books of the Parsis*, 1886–96, Public Domain), via avesta.org, in `source-ave-2.json`.
